messages:
incident-bot: [AUTO] High error-rate detected: routing policy 'global-fairness' producing repeated model-compatibility failures and cross-region traffic spikes starting ~13:03 UTC. Paging @sre_oncall :rotating_light:

sre_oncall: Ack. I'm on-call. Triage please. Who's owner for routing schema? Pinging @eng_runtime and @rob_k.

nina_s: Jumping in. Seeing a loop: primary picks 'prod-v3' -> fallback to eu-west picks 'prod-v3-q4' which returns incompatible response code -> client retries -> request routed back to primary -> ends up bouncing between regions until TTL. Traffic multiplier caused cost spike.

rob_k: I pulled the saved policy for customer group 'global-fairness'. There's an old field `regional_priority_order` present. New schema expects `variant_precedence` and `region_preference` separately. During the recent config migration, `regional_priority_order` was dropped from the active config and runtime defaulted to `ALLOW_ANY_VARIANT` when `variant_precedence` missing. That permissive default is what allowed the incompatible quantized variant to be chosen.

rob_k: snippet from the policy stored in vault:
```yaml
# legacy policy snippet
regional_priority_order: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
variant_list: [prod-v3]
# After migration, variant_precedence is empty
variant_precedence: []  # missing due to migration bug
```

eng_runtime: Immediate mitigations: (1) disable cross-region fallback for this policy, (2) inject explicit variant_precedence using last-known-good snapshot, (3) raise an alert when variant_precedence is empty. I'll do (1) and (2) now.

eng_runtime: Running: `redwoodctl policy apply --id global-fairness --set allow_cross_region_fallback=false --set variant_precedence="[\"prod-v3\", \"prod-v2\"]" --reason "emergency stopgap"`

deploy-bot: Job 11077 submitted by eng_runtime. Live console: https://ci.internal/logs/11077

nina_s: Change applied. Error rates dropping. Retry storms subsided within two minutes. Billing spike contained.

ops_j: Who is affected customer-wise? We need to notify accounts and legal if necessary.

rob_k: Affected customers: Searchly (hosted), AtlasRetail (dedicated), internal perf tests. Searchly saw 15% of requests erroring, P1. Estimated failed requests ~9k in 45m. Also noticed ~30% increase in inter-region egress during incident.

acct_team: Notifying Searchly account team and sending initial incident email.

eng_runtime: Root cause: migration tool that translates legacy keys to new schema had a branch that removed `regional_priority_order` instead of translating it when `variant_list` present. Runtime accepted empty `variant_precedence` and applied permissive fallback semantics. Fix: patch migration to populate `variant_precedence` from `variant_list` and treat missing precedence as fail-fast rather than permissive.

rob_k: Opening PR with fix and canned migration: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/377. Also adding a runtime guard: if `variant_precedence` is empty and fallbacks are enabled -> reject policy load and emit metric `routing.policy_invalid_load`.

deploy-bot: PR 377 merged to staging. Canary started in us-east.

eng_runtime: Canary passed. Rolling hotfix to prod in 3 waves (5%, 25%, 100%).

nina_s: Canary 5% looked stable, starting 25%.

deploy-bot: Prod rollout at 100% complete. Metrics: policy_invalid_load triggered for ~6 policies during migration window; backfilled values restored from snapshots. No further loops seen.

ops_j: Customer comms: provisional message drafted: "We experienced intermittent failures caused by a configuration migration that removed legacy routing keys; a temporary mitigation was applied and a hotfix has been deployed. We'll follow up with a postmortem and timeline." Approve?

sre_oncall: Approve. Please include note about egress cost spike and whom to contact for cost reimbursements.

acct_team: Notified Searchly and AtlasRetail, offering credits where appropriate.

eng_runtime: Follow-ups: 1) Add CI migration smoke test covering legacy keys -> new schema. 2) Add Console UX banner when deprecated keys exist. 3) Add alert rule for repeated model-compatibility failures per policy. 4) Run audit across policies for empty variant_precedence.

incident-bot: Incident updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Timeline: detection 13:03, emergency mitigation 13:08, hotfix rollout 13:52, full resolution 14:05.

rob_k: Creating INC ticket INC-2026-489 and attaching relevant config diffs, logs, and the PR.

eng_runtime: Handoff to @nina_s for overnight watch. Please verify metrics for cross-region egress and model-compatibility errors at 4h and 24h.

nina_s: Ack. I'll run scheduled checks at 17:00 UTC and 03:00 UTC, and will escalate if any anomalies.

ops_j: Great job team. :clap: Closing page and moving to postmortem scheduling.
